bio.text: Mike Haridopolos was elected in 2024 to represent Florida's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House, succeeding the retiring Rep. Bill Posey.
He taught U.S. history and political science at Brevard Community College, served in the Florida House and Senate from 2000 to 2012, and was President of the Florida Senate from 2010 to 2012.
After leaving office he started a business and political consulting company; he lives in Indian Harbour Beach.
